title: Post-restart deployment-control hardening
summary: Hardened Cloudron release and rollback controls so platform ownership normalization cannot make authenticated runtime controls application-writable after a restart.
changes: Added mode-based immutable release boundaries that survive Cloudron ownership normalization while retaining the required writable Laravel cache and shared-storage paths.
Reauthenticated the fixed deployment-control set into a root-only runtime directory after restart and immediately before rollback, then verified the live write boundaries before health acceptance.
affected_areas: Cloudron release restart, runtime-control authentication, and exact-release rollback
version_rationale: A backward-compatible patch correcting the post-restart ownership boundary discovered during v0.8.1 production verification.
validation: Deployment contract tests require authenticated post-restart and pre-rollback control extraction, exact fixed-path hashes, root-only runtime controls, and non-writable active and rollback release boundaries for the application user.
The complete SQLite, MySQL 8.4, MariaDB 11.4, frontend, packaging, migration, authorization, health, OIDC, and post-restart production gates remain required before issue completion.
known_limitations: This patch changes deployment and rollback hardening only; it does not alter the v0.8.0 authorization or Admin feature set.
rollback: Restore the exact pre-activation application release while retaining the forward-only Phase B database migration; rollback controls must still pass the externally authenticated runtime-control and immutable-release gates.
provenance: Defined by post-restart production evidence for Phase B of MyAPES Account issue #10.
